affected_planes.profile: SMAP/PKE are advertised. SMEP enforcement is limited to externally injected state; CPUID and CR4_SUPPORTED_MASK remain unchanged and MOV-to-CR4 still rejects enabling SMEP.

validation.fixture_correction: The SMEP guest-write control originally expected a raw GeneralProtection error. Direct MOV-to-CR injects vector 13; with no installed IDT, the fixture triple-faults. The final control checks vector 13 delivery and unchanged control/PC state. The original fixture mismatch is retained in profile-control-fixture-mismatch.log.

rosetta_new_native_cache_checks.basis: Both cases passed in the ongoing full library run; no filtered-only run is claimed.

rosetta_library.note: The broader host run continues after this group commit. Four previously reproduced Darwin/Rosetta host failures remain separately registered.

bounded_scope.item: Legacy/PAE paging, complete checkpoint/scheduling work and remaining architecture/platform findings stay pending.

Protected system paging intentionally executes through software instruction boundaries until native memory callbacks carry live AC/PKRU state. This may reduce native execution coverage; no performance claim is made.
Software tests implement verified primary-source predicates; no physical privileged x86 or independent QEMU-system run has yet established equivalence.
Permission checks use fixed-width masks and constant work per translated chunk; key metadata adds one byte before structure padding. No whole-VM performance estimate is inferred.
SMEP is not an advertised guest capability. Its predicate supplies externally injected-state consistency only; the explicit guest enablement rejection is retained.

group_scope_notes: Each group records limits at its own validation point; findings contains the current disposition.
